messages:
Renee CSM: Quick request — creating a single-sheet "kickoff handshake" for customers to paste into kickoff notes. Needs to cover: prefill, batching guidance, streaming fallback, simple health checks, and renewal triggers. Keep it copyable.
Ethan SE: Good. Make two sections: one for AEs/customers (plain language) and one for Ops (exact knobs + snippets).
Maya DevEx: I'll add two copy/paste examples: a small prefill POST and a basic PromQL check.
Cal CS: Add a tiny "what we'll do if things go wrong" section so customers feel reassured.
Renee CSM: Drafting now. Customer-facing paragraph (1 line): "We'll prefill warm context for your top flows and monitor p95 latency; expected warm window ~10 minutes during ramp."
Ethan SE: Ops knobs (copy): prefill_ttl=900s default (increase to 1800s for heavy context), warm_pool=true for enterprise tenants, burst_pool_ttl=300s, batch_target_tokens=1024 for balanced cost/latency.
Maya DevEx: Prefill POST (copy):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","intents":["intentA","intentB"],"ttl":900}'
```
Maya DevEx: PromQL smoke healthcheck (copy):
```promql
p95(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_sum[5m])
```
Ethan SE: Quick client pattern: add 0-200ms jitter + 2 retries for short ops; if stream_error_rate > 7% for 15m, switch to non-streaming route and notify SE.
Cal CS: Renewal signals (copy): p95 > 1s sustained for 24h, cache hit < 35% for 48h, stream error rate > 7% for 3 days, WoW cost jump > 20% — triggers CS outreach.
Renee CSM: Recovery play (copy): 1) enable 300s burst pool + prefill top-20 intents; 2) reduce batch_target_tokens to 512 during spike; 3) route to quantized model with QA gate if cost control needed.
InfraBot: Confluence page created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/kickoff-handshake-sheet
Renee CSM: Nice. I'll attach this to the kickoff template and send to AE. Thanks :heart:
